skill_name: Create a speech to inspire people to help the environment.
workflow: Good evening everyone. We are all here tonight to recognize the importance of taking care of the environment. We are all so fortunate to live on this beautiful planet and yet, many of us fail to recognize and preserve its beauty. Too often, we take for granted the clean air we breathe, the clean water we drink, and the abundant wildlife that populate our landscapes.
